facts.subject_label: IFRS S2 Climate-related Disclosures :: IFRS S2 transition risks
facts.evidence_source_1: IFRS S1 and S2 project summary
facts.evidence_source_2: Applying IFRS S1 when reporting only climate-related disclosures under IFRS S2
facts.key_statement_1: Specifically, paragraph 27 of IFRS S2 sets out the objective of climate-related disclosures on metrics and targets, which is equivalent to the objective for metrics and targets in paragraph 45 of IFRS S1, except focused on climate-related risks and opportunities.
facts.key_statement_2: However, some of the requirements in IFRS S1 are not applicable when reporting on only climate-related risks and opportunities (in accordance with IFRS S2) because either specific corresponding requirements for climate-related disclosures are already included in IFRS S2
facts.scope_condition: Reporting period where entity applies IFRS S1 but reports only climate-related disclosures under IFRS S2
